instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Synapse is a management consulting firm specializing in complex operational strategy and digital transformation for mid-market enterprises. With a team of 40 consultants, the company operates under rigorous compliance standards due to the sensitive nature of enterprise data and industry regulations. Their core service delivery involves long-term project cycles demanding high levels of expertise.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. We did not invest enough in understanding whether our specific customer base actually wanted self-service before building.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months, threatening established service contracts. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through deep niche specialization and developing proprietary operational frameworks that are too costly for new entrants to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: Internal knowledge silos exist across business units, slowing down the integration of new operational insights into core consulting offerings.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: Proprietary Knowledge Asset Library (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the current investment in knowledge management AI to create a hyper-specific data moat that automates proposal generation and service design. This radical move protects market share by making our specialized operational insights exponentially more valuable than generic competitor offerings.

first_actions: Integrate existing CRM/ERP data streams into the AI platform's knowledge base (Q1)
Define 5 high-value, proprietary consulting frameworks to seed the learning model (Q2)
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Data scientist contract or internal training
Software licensing for advanced LLM/AI integration API
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce proposal generation time by 40% while maintaining margin stability.
milestones: Pilot AI-driven proposal generation for one specific service line (Month 3)
Internal validation of framework adoption across all three offices (Month 6)

opportunities.title: Tiered Self-Service Customer Portal (Conservative)
opportunities.rationale: Address the failed self-service experiment by focusing on a highly targeted, low-risk MVP aimed at improving client experience and reducing administrative overhead. This provides quick wins in customer retention without demanding massive platform overhaul.

first_actions: Conduct qualitative interviews with top 10% of clients to define minimum viable features (Q1)
Allocate dedicated sprint capacity for the 5 engineers to build a localized portal prototype (Q2)
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve an 15% increase in client login/engagement rate within the pilot group.
milestones: Review and prioritize feature roadmap based on initial feedback (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional 'Defense Task Force' to audit existing intellectual property and identify the top 3 areas for radical knowledge asset development.
Allocate specific engineering resources (1 FTE) solely focused on integrating data streams into the Knowledge Management AI platform to accelerate pilot readiness.
Develop a formal, quarterly 'Innovation Review' structure for the small leadership team, ensuring budget alignment with market defense goals.

key_weaknesses: Low digital maturity (Level 2) limits the ability to rapidly scale new services or customer-facing products.
Informal innovation process leads to inconsistent execution velocity and fragmented knowledge silos across offices.
High dependency on individual consultant expertise rather than standardized, scalable frameworks increases churn risk.
Limited budget allocation (15%) restricts the capacity for significant large-scale infrastructure investment needed for radical digital transformation.
